flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch (form/NoticeSearchAllForm, hook/useSearchParams, component/NoticeSearchSlot), utils/validation/NoticeSearch, route in App.tsx; ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeServiceImpl (validoffencenoticelist search + owner_driver join), api-authorization.properties. ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: not relevant
note: The Staff Portal has a Notice Search page (route notices/search/:search_type) with Notice No., Vehicle No. and ID No. fields sent to the validoffencenoticelist endpoint; the ID No. filter is joined to the owner_driver table in the backend. Results are links to the notice page. The search is generic for all notices and is not filtered to furnishable notices (that is checked in stories 41.42/41.43). Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'. The mapping of the Notice Processing Officer role to functionId OCMS_NOTICE_SEARCH is held in ACM, cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Can be claimed. All three search indicators exist and are wired to the backend.

steps.step: Officer opens the Notice Search page in the Staff Portal
steps.detail: Route notices/search/:search_type (NoticeSearchProvider + NoticeSearch.Search) renders the Search Notices form and the result list. Endpoint access is defined in api-authorization.properties:21-26 (OCMS_NOTICE_SEARCH); the role-to-functionId mapping cannot be verified from the repo.
TextInput source notice_no (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:64) is mapped to param noticeNo[$in] (useSearchParams.tsx:322) and sent to validoffencenoticelist.
TextInput source vehicle_no (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:81) is mapped to param vehicleNo (useSearchParams.tsx:325) to validoffencenoticelist.

steps.step: Officer searches by the owner/hirer/driver ID Number
steps.detail: TextInput source id_no (NoticeSearchAllForm.tsx:542) is sent as param idNo (useSearchParams.tsx:530). In the backend, idNo is recognised as an owner/driver filter (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeServiceImpl.java:49, 173-211) and run through findByOwnerDriverInfo against the owner_driver table, so notices are found by the owner/hirer/driver ID.

steps.step: Search results can be opened for the update
steps.detail: The result link points to #/notices/view/{notice_no} (NoticeSearchSlot.tsx:75); the view/:notice_no and edit/:notice_no routes are in App.tsx:151-152; the Owner/Hirer/Driver tab is on that page (see 41.43).
